Class Student

java.lang.Object
project.User
project.Student
public class Student extends User
Represents a student user in the internship management system. Inherits from the User class and includes additional attributes A student has a major, year of study, and a maximum number of applications allowed.

      public boolean canApplyForLevel(String internshipLevel)
      Checks whether this student can apply for a given internship level Students in year 1-2 can only apply for BASIC level internships, while students in year 3-4 can apply for any level.
